subject: Proposal: Split demo into product + compliance sessions (BluePeak)
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <eortiz@bluepeakhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: split demo into product + compliance sessions (BluePeak)

Hi Elena —

Thanks again for coordinating the demo next week. I heard from your admin that procurement and security asked to join the run-through; that’s great but will meaningfully change the scope. To make sure we cover both the product flow and the governance/controls detail your teams expect, can I propose splitting into two shorter sessions instead of one long meeting?

Option A (recommended):
- Session 1 — Product walkthrough (30–40 min): targeted to product owners and end-users; we demo core flows and integrations.
- Session 2 — Controls + procurement deep-dive (45–60 min): runbook for data handling, SOC/Security artifacts, network topology, procurement terms, and procurement checklist review.

This lets us keep the product demo concise for the PMs and gives your security/procurement teams a focused block where Priyom (security lead) and Marissa (solutions engineer) can bring the technical artifacts and procurement checklist. Vivek will join for post-demo next steps and SOW/ops questions.

Attached: rough pre-demo agenda and a security deck we can expand on. If you prefer one consolidated session we can do a 90-minute block but I worry that will be tiring and less actionable for procurement.

Proposed times (all PT):
- Tue Dec 8, 10:00–10:45 (Product) + 11:15–12:00 (Compliance)
- Wed Dec 9, 09:30–10:15 (Product) + 11:00–11:45 (Compliance)

Can you confirm which day works for the stakeholders? If procurement has travel conflicts we can flip to Dec 10–11 as alternatives.

Thanks —
Mateo Alvarez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Attachments: pre-demo-agenda.pdf, security-deck-v2.pdf

Hi Mateo —

Thanks for the clear breakdown. We added our security lead (Darren) and procurement as you mentioned — both groups flagged the need to see the control set and procurement milestones. Generally I prefer a single session so execs can hear the story end-to-end, but procurement will be traveling Dec 8–9, so your two-session approach makes sense.

Quick notes:
- Procurement available Dec 10 after 13:00 PT.
- Darren (security) prefers morning slots.

Can we try: Wednesday Dec 9 for Product (09:30 PT) and Friday Dec 11 for Compliance (10:00 PT)? That splits them and avoids procurement travel. If that is tight for Redwood, propose the alternative set.

Elena Ortiz
